## More about tiers

The more you earn, the greater the discounts you unlock on future purchases. Once you unlock a membership level, there is no going backwards unless your account goes inactive for 24 months with no purchases.

### How to move between the tiers?

When buying/selling with us you will be awarded points for every transaction. As you start collecting these points you will gradually move through the different tier levels and unlock new benefits.

### How many tier points you’ll earn from buying from us?

You earn 1 point for every £1 you spend with us, so spending £1000 will get you 1000 tier points.

### How many tier points you’ll earn from selling to us?

You earn 1/2 point for every £1 you spend with us, so spending £1000 will get you 500 tier points.

### What are the benefits of the membership?

Benefits include reduced buying margins, increased seller rates, priority collections, deliveries and advanced support.
